properties.description:
Anthony's word, 2026-09-21: raise NEAR_MATCH_LIMIT and pin it with a test. Follows the measurement in fact:the-near-match-guard-shows-three-of-a-nine-way-tie-so-relevance-is-decided-by-score-noise, where nine non-self hits cleared the floor, three were shown, and the genuinely duplicated node sat at rank 4 — six thousandths of a point behind rank 5.

WHAT LANDS: the constant moves from 3 to 6, and crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/the_near_match_report_is_not_cut_at_three.rs pins the CLASS — a band of eight close nodes is not reported as three, and the report stays bounded by the query window, so removing the cap is not a way to make it green.

WHAT THIS EPOCH DOES NOT CLAIM: it does not claim the cut is now in the right place. The floor is relative to a self-score that sits structurally far above every other hit, so it lands inside a dense band whatever the limit is; raising the limit buys margin and does not change that shape. Whether the SCORE is the right instrument for this question at all is untouched and open.

⚠️ AND IT WIDENS THE REFUSAL SURFACE, which is the part a later reader should not have to rediscover: NEAR_MATCH_LIMIT governs both what is SHOWN and what is REFUSED, because refuse_unless_deliberate reads the already-truncated list. Doubling it doubles how many unacknowledged near-matches can block a write.
properties.name: The near-match report stops being cut at three (2026-09-21)
